cbse-c8e3122144: PRESS RELEASE New Delhi, 29.9.2026 CBSE Holds Live Q&A Webinar on Registration and LOC for Board Examinations 2027 Webinar highlights CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) organised a live webinar on “Relevance of Registration & LOC” today at the Auditorium, CBSE Integrated Office, Dwarka, New Delhi. The webinar was organised in continuation of CBSE’s circulars relating to the submission of the List of Candidates (LOC) for the Class X and Class XII Board Examinations 2027 and correction of demographic details of students. The webinar highlighted CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent. Schools were encouraged to ensure correctness at every stage of Registration and LOC submission and provide timely guidance to students and parents, wherever required. They were also encouraged to resolve issues well in advance so that students can remain focused on their studies without being burdened by avoidable procedural difficulties. CBSE has already commenced the LOC process for the Secondary and Senior Secondary Board Examinations 2027 and will shortly commence the Registration process for students of Classes IX and XI. These processes cover students studying in nearly 32,000 CBSE-affiliated schools across India and 26 countries. A key highlight of the Webinar was a Live Q&A session, wherein questions received from principals and teachers were answered during the programme by senior CBSE Officials. The questions broadly related to correction of student particulars, selection and change of subjects, submission and verification of LOC data, Registration of students in Classes IX and XI, fee-related provisions etc. The Controller of Examinations made a presentation during the session on salient aspects of the Registration and LoC process. During the webinar, emphasis was laid on the timely and accurate submission of Registration and LOC data, particularly the correctness of student particulars and subject combinations, compliance with fee -related provisions, and appropriate implementation of provisions relating to Children with Special Needs (CWSN). The programme was live -streamed on CBSE’s official YouTube channel and witnessed large scale participation of students, parents and other stakeholders. More than 450 school principals and educators from CBSE -affiliated schools participated in the programme in person at the CBSE Integrated Office, Dwarka. CBSE has advised all stakeholders to regularly visit the Board’s official website, www.cbse.gov.in, for authentic and updated information relating to Registration, LOC and Board Examinations. Controller of Examinations, CBSE
cbse-7d4d72f94a: 18.07.2026 PRESS RELEASE CBSE Declares Class X Second Board Examination Results 2026 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has declared the results of the Class X Second Board Examination, 2026. Students can access their results through DigiLocker Results Portal at the URL: results.digilocker.gov.in In line with the recommendations of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, CBSE had introduced two Board Examinations for Class X from 2026. The Main Board Examination was conducted from 17th February to 11th March 2026, followed by the Second Board Examination from 15th May to 21st May 2026. The Second Board Examination provided eligible students of the Main Board Examination of 2026 with an additional opportunity to improve their performance. Accordingly, for regular students of the 2026, the better of the two performances is considered for preparing the final result. A. Statistics of Second Board Examination, 2026 S. No. Details Number 1 Total Candidates Registered for Second Board Examination 2026 6,64,027 2 Total Candidates Appeared in Second Board Examination 2026 6,63,777 3 Candidates who Appeared for Improvement 5,13,955 4 Candidates who improved their performance over the Main Examination 3,08,095 (59.95%) 5 Candidates who Appeared in Compartment Category 1,49,822 6 Candidates who passed in the Compartment Category 78,503 (52.40%)* 7 Overall pass percentage after combining the results of the Main and Second Board Examinations of 2026 96.78% *Pass Percentage in Compartment Category-2025 was 48.68 % School-wise results will also be communicated to schools through their registered email addresses. Schools may also access the digital academic documents of their students through the repository using the credentials already provided by CBSE. B. Students of CBSE Affiliated Schools Abroad Students of CBSE -affiliated schools abroad will also be able to access their results and digital academic documents through DigiLocker. C. Printed Marksheets Printed Mark Sheet-cum-Passing Certificates of regular students, including those studying abroad, will be supplied through their respective schools. Private candidates will also be provided digital academic documents through DigiLocker. Printed documents will be sent to their registered addresses. However, private candidates under the Delhi East and Delhi West Regional Offices may collect their printed documents from the examination centres from which they appeared. D. Post Result Services Details of the post-result facilities will be notified separately through an official circular. CBSE appeals to students and parents not to rely on unverified social media posts, rumours, or unofficial sources regarding the result process. Authentic and updated information shall be made available through CBSE's official communication channels. For any queries, candidates may write to resultcbse2026@cbseshiksha.in or contact their respective CBSE Regional Offices or CBSE Tele-Helplines. Controller of Examinations

cbse-311de87f6c: 21.06.2026 PRESS RELEASE CBSE Commences Release of Class XII Verification of Issues observed and Re-evaluation Outcomes; CBSE assures that every application has been processed through a robust and carefully monitored system to ensure fairness and accuracy; CBSE appeals students not to believe on rumours and unsubstantiated social media posts CBSE Regional Offices available for any assistance/guidance to students The outcomes of applications submitted by Class XII candidates under the Post-Result Services for Verification of Issues observed and Re-evaluation are being released on Digi Locker from today, i.e. 21st June 2026 onwards. Candidates whose marks have been revised as a result of the verification of Issues observed or re- evaluation process may access their updated Class XII marksheets through Digi Locker at https://results.digilocker.gov.in/ . The outcomes will be released in a phased manner as and when the processing of individual applications is completed. Today, the results of around 87% of candidates who have applied for Re-evaluation and/or Verification of Issues observed have been declared. The outcomes for the remaining candidates will also be released in phases and the entire process is expected to be completed soon. The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) had declared the results of the Class XII Examinations 2026 on 13 May 2026 for approximately 17.69 lakh candidates. As part of its post-result services, CBSE had provided candidates with the facility to obtain scanned copies of their evaluated answer books from 19th May to 25th May 2026. Subsequently, candidates were given the opportunity to apply for Verification of Issues observed and/or Re - evaluation from 2nd June to 7th June 2026. The post-result Services platform functioned under the supervision of technical experts from the Digital India Corporation, IIT Kanpur and IIT Madras who supported the CBSE team to safeguard the system against unauthorised and malicious access and to ensur e the integrity of the entire process. As has been done last year, in all such cases of Verification of Issues observed, where the claim of the candidate has been established, the same is being corrected and evaluated by CBSE and their marks updated. The candidates can see status of their requests on the Digilocker. Candidates who applied for the verification of Issues observed and for whom CBSE has reported the outcome as "No-change", would be offered an opportunity, if they wish to inspect their answer books at the concerned CBSE Regional Office. The schedule for the same would be released soon. CBSE appeals to students and parents not to rely on unverified social media posts, rumours , or unofficial sources regarding the post -result process. Authentic and updated information shall be made available through CBSE's official communication channels.
